items.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
items.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

items.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
items.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”

items.title: ‘I’m never selling’: I’m 47 and buy bitcoin with every dollar I earn. Am I crazy?
items.description: “When my paycheck lands, it takes a detour through bitcoin.”

items.title: SpaceX’s next big growth engine isn’t rockets — it’s this play on AI power, analysts say
items.description: The company has a lucrative opportunity in letting rivals tap its data centers for computing power.

items.title: AMD makes a big bet on the next era of AI with World Labs acquisition
items.description: The chip maker is buying the startup and adding AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li as its chief scientist.

items.title: Nvidia makes a statement with historic $150 billion buyback announcement
items.description: The company intends to repurchase a large amount of shares through January 2028, reflecting its “confidence in the long-term opportunity ahead.”

items.title: MongoDB’s stock is down nearly 20% as CEO decamps to Meta
items.description: Meta is creating an enterprise platform business that aims to make it easier for developers to use its products. CJ Desai, formerly of MongoDB, will head up the initiative.

items.title: This AI startup has only 14 employees — and a fresh $10 billion valuation
items.description: Instinct is rapidly amassing investment dollars, illustrating the rush of excitement around personal AI assistants.

items.title: ‘I’d rather be on a beach in Bali’: My husband resents my $8 million net worth. Should I pay for his retirement?
Bond yields move relentlessly higher, as Wall Street wonders how much more tech stocks can take
items.description: Wall Street was hoping last week’s bond rout was the worst of it. Monday indicated otherwise.
